name: video-template-boss-reveal-cinematic
title: Boss Reveal Cinematic
description: A 10-second in-engine style boss introduction: the arena goes quiet, the boss emerges in silhouette, a signature move and roar, then the camera returns to the gameplay view as the boss health bar and name plate slide in. Usable as a trailer climax or a gameplay reference.

description_i18n.en: A 10-second in-engine style boss introduction: the arena goes quiet, the boss emerges in silhouette, a signature move and roar, then the camera returns to the gameplay view as the boss health bar and name plate slide in. Usable as a trailer climax or a gameplay reference.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 一段 10 秒的引擎内风格 Boss 登场演出：竞技场安静下来，Boss 以剪影现身，展示招牌动作并咆哮，随后镜头回到游戏视角，Boss 血条与名牌滑入。可作为预告片高潮或玩法参考。

query.en:
A 10-second boss reveal in the style of an in-engine game cinematic, ending back in the playable view.

Game: {argument name="game_pitch" default="a dark 2D action platformer set in a drowned bell tower"}.
Art style: {argument name="art_style" default="hand-painted 2D with dramatic lighting and smooth skeletal animation"}.
Boss: {argument name="boss" default="a colossal bell-headed sentinel made of rusted bronze and seaweed, with chains for arms"}.
Arena: {argument name="arena" default="a circular flooded chamber with broken stained glass and moonlight falling through the roof"}.

# Timeline
- 0-2s CALM: the player character enters the arena from the left in the normal gameplay camera; ambient sound drops away, drips echo.
- 2-4.5s EMERGENCE: the camera eases into a low angle as the boss rises from the water in silhouette, backlit by {argument name="backlight" default="cold moonlight through the broken window"}, water pouring off it.
- 4.5-7s SIGNATURE: the boss performs its signature move, {argument name="signature_move" default="swinging its bell head so the toll sends a visible shockwave rippling across the water"}, then roars; the screen shakes and dust falls.
- 7-10s HANDOFF: the camera pulls back to the exact gameplay framing, the player in a ready stance; a boss health bar slides in along the bottom of the screen with the name plate "{argument name="boss_name" default="The Drowned Toll"}" above it, short and clearly legible.

# Readability
- The boss silhouette is readable at a glance: one strong shape, glowing weak point at {argument name="weak_point" default="the cracked bell mouth"}.
- Palette: {argument name="palette" default="cold blue-green shadows, bronze and rust midtones, sickly yellow glow on the weak point"}.
- Sound: a deep bell toll on the signature move, roar, low choir swell on the handoff.

# Avoid
Gore, misspelled or extra on-screen text beyond the boss name, a camera angle at the end that differs from gameplay, morphing boss anatomy, existing franchise creatures, watermarks.
